Most days remain dry, but rain chances return late in the week. Meteorologist Derek Bowen has your DC Weather Now 7-Day Forecast. Man killed in Southeast DC shooting, police seek … Police said that a man was killed in a Wednesday shooting in D.C. 10th Annual DC Spring Cleanup event set for this … In celebration of Earth Day, the 10th Annual DC Spring Cleanup will take place on Saturday, April 25. How Montgomery County, Md. taxes could change There's a budget debate in Maryland that could lead to families in Montgomery County paying more in taxes. New $5,000 fee for some Maryland businesses Prince George's County is moving forward with a fee on certain businesses, including liquor stores and smoke shops. DC police: Man fired gun at officers, officer fired … One person is in custody after a shooting in Northwest, D.C. on Wednesday afternoon, police said. Thieves target Laurel cars, stealing airbags from … Police said that thieves broke into 20 cars in Laurel overnight on Tuesday. Metro unveils Earth Day buses designed by students … Metro celebrated Earth Day on Wednesday by unveiling a new fleet of buses designed by students across the DMV. Top Stories from DC News Now at 9 p.m. on April 22, … Top stories making headlines in D.C., Maryland and Virginia on April 22, 2026. DC superintendent takes new steps to track chronic … The Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE) has launched a new dashboard to track school attendance in the District. 2-year-old found safe after mother killed in DC; … An AMBER Alert was canceled after a 2-year-old boy was found safe. The child's mother was shot and killed in D.C. on Tuesday night, the Metropolitan Police Department said. Slightly warmer Thursday, thunderstorm chances Friday … Chief Meteorologist Jackie Layer has your Wednesday evening forecast update for the DMV.
